description.value:
You don't out-muscle the wasteland's monsters. You out-think them, and leave before they notice you were there.

SIGNATURE — your Marked quarry takes a penalty to notice or react to you and your Feral Bond specifically.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry/origin:mark:quarry is live). Two things remain: (1) this card's own missing number -- Ranger's Outwit classfeature is the exact real analog (FlatModifier to AC/Perception/skills, predicate origin:mark:hunted-prey), buildable the same way once this card states the actual penalty; (2) the "and your Feral Bond" half is a genuine second gap, confirmed this pass: no rule-element selector lets one actor's item apply a penalty/bonus scoped to a different actor's (the Feral Bond's) own defenses -- same cross-actor limitation already documented on waywarden.companions-fury.json and waywarden.snapjaw.json. Owner will supply the number; the companion half needs its own call.
